summary: One-character fix adds trailing space after 'DISTINCT' so the aggregate template no longer concatenates 'DISTINCT' directly onto the next expression (e.g. COUNT(DISTINCTCASE...)). Correct, minimal, general fix matching the canonical Django patch; produces exactly one space and leaves the non-distinct branch as empty string, so no double-space or regression.

issues.description: Encoding a significant trailing space inside a string literal ('DISTINCT ') is slightly less self-documenting than putting the separator in the template, and trailing-space literals are easy to mangle later. Acceptable as-is; non-blocking nit.
